pr_title: task: Do not substitute Zed variables in command and env
pr_body:
/cc @SomeoneToIgnore 
Fixes https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12627
Release Notes:

- Task variables are no longer substituted in `env` or `command` before handing it off to shell.
pr_comments: Yeah, that'd mean that this `command` would become fully unsubstituted. How'd you feel about just printing the task variables from the context instead?
I personally think having a fully substituted command outputted is really useful and should not be removed. It really helps to immediately see what was being executed
I'll close out this PR given unclearness around displaying substituted variables.

issue_context.title: Add a `selected text or current buffer` variable in tasks
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [X] Completed

### Describe the feature

Add a `selected text or current buffer` variable in tasks. If there is no text selected, the value of the variable default to current whole buffer. With this variable, the below two tasks can be merged into one

```
  {
    "label": "Dpaste (File)",
    "command": "cat $ZED_FILE | curl -s -F \"content=<-\" https://dpaste.com/api/v2/ | pbcopy",
    "use_new_terminal": false,
    "allow_concurrent_runs": false,
    "reveal": "never"
  },
  {
    "label": "Dpaste (Region)",
    "command": "echo -e \"$ZED_SELECTED_TEXT\" | curl -s -F \"content=<-\" https://dpaste.com/api/v2/ | pbcopy",
    "use_new_terminal": false,
    "allow_concurrent_runs": false,
    "reveal": "never"
  }
```
------------------------------
This is a common pattern in Emacs, e.g.

```
  (crux-with-region-or-line kill-region)
  (crux-with-region-or-buffer eval-region)
  (crux-with-region-or-buffer untabify)
  (crux-with-region-or-buffer indent-region)
...
```

- If there a region, kill that region, otherwise kill current line
- If there a region, evaluate that region, otherwise evaluate current buffer
- If there a region, remove all tabs in region, otherwise remove all tabs of current buffer
- If there a region, indent that region, otherwise indent the whole buffer
- ...

### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature


_No response_

`${ZED_SELECTED_TEXT:-$(cat "$ZED_FILE")}`
instead of $ZED_SELECTED_TEXT
It may not work if you're using fish though.

But still — I think we'd want to reuse the substituted label at least, somewhere.
